doc.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]

chapter: Dorsey band and moving to New York
title: Arriving in New York with no work
summary: Moving to New York broke, six months without work, nearly taking a photo lab job.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: It is wild, really. So I left after eight months and came to New York, and not a penny was saved incidentally in that time. So that was a disaster.

Yeah. So I came to New York, knew no one, I was there for six months — in fact I moved to New York with the hairdresser from the show. This tells you what a crazy thing it was, subletting an apartment from an actress who I’d had an affair with and then her husband found out about it.
